## 0083f06314c3

**Status: Reproduced shortcut and categorical coverage gap; target left unchanged.** Target generator SHA-256 is `1dc411f3292d41aa1ff31fac19da37eff4bf1a65d0fc972b965126915e352089`; authoritative rule hash is `6a4eb398052b`.

The documented/validated branch is selector color 2 → panel A and any other accepted non-divider selector color → panel B. Across **240/240 generated cases** (3 bands × 4 profiles × 20 seeds), selector color 1 never appeared; observed counts were `{2:120, 3:69, 4:8, 5:10, 6:11, 7:10, 8:12}`. A rival that maps color 1 to panel A, color 2 to panel A, and all other colors to panel B matched authoritative Racket on all 240 generated cases and all 3 canonical pairs.

The retained counterexample starts from easy/profile-2/seed-85000, changes the valid selector from color 3 to color 1, and leaves the rest of the input unchanged. The target `self_check` accepts it with no findings. Authoritative Racket selects panel B; the rival selects panel A. Thus color 1 is inside the accepted/documented domain but absent from both the sampled generator support and canonical lessons.

The exact input, authoritative output, rival output, selector census, hashes, and provenance are in `checks/audits/0083f06314c3_audit.json`; replay code is `checks/audits/probe_0083f06314c3.py`.

triage.reason: Both audit reports retained against exact target hashes; census results remain reviewer-reported. Repair targets are not modified by audits. Findings are visible to future assignments via task indexes.
